defect: a one-cycle fast-domain pulse is sampled directly by the slower destination clock
rationale: pulse_fast can begin and end between clk_slow edges, so pulse_slow can miss a source event entirely.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: A short pulse from the fast clock is sampled directly by the 4x slower clock with no stretching or toggle, so it can be missed, and there is no second stage.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the source-pulse and destination-pulse interface context, reduced the toggle and edge-detection implementation, and exposed the direct destination sampling in a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Connected the fast-domain pulse directly to the slow-domain sequential assignment without pulse stretching or event encoding.
